annotations.title: Manage a Meta pixel (sharing, people, health)

description: One Meta pixel on an ad account this brand chose: action get (default; the full pixel: install snippet, when it last fired, owner business, automatic advanced matching and its fields, first-party cookies) | update (name, enableAutomaticMatching, automaticMatchingFields, firstPartyCookies enabled/disabled, dataUseSetting; read back; switching matching or first-party cookies OFF lowers measurement for every ad on the pixel, so it needs confirm:true after the user agrees) | shared_accounts (the ad accounts it is shared with) | share / unshare (targetAdAccountId, which must be one of this brand's ad accounts; unshare stops that account's ads measuring on it, so it needs confirm:true) | users (the business people on it, with their tasks) | assign_user (userId from manage_meta_business list_people, tasks AA_ANALYZE / ADVERTISE / ANALYZE / EDIT / UPLOAD; an assignment replaces their tasks, so narrowing them needs confirm:true) | remove_user (Meta has no API for it: the reply says where to do it) | partners (the partner businesses it is shared with; sharing with a new partner is done in Business Settings) | diagnostics (Meta's Events Manager checks: missing parameters, catalog mismatches) | stats (event counts by aggregation, default event; since / until). pixelId is the id or the exact name from list_meta_pixels. Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or digits) the pixel is on or shared with; it must be one this brand has shared

aggregation.description: stats: event (default), host, url, device_type, browser_type, match_keys, event_source, …

automaticMatchingFields.description: update: the fields matched, from em, fn, ln, ph, ge, zp, ct, st, country, db, external_id

confirm.description: true after the user agreed (lowering matching / cookies, unshare, narrowing someone's tasks)

dataUseSetting.description: update: Meta's data use setting, e.g. ADVERTISING_AND_ANALYTICS or ANALYTICS_ONLY

enableAutomaticMatching.description: update: automatic advanced matching on or off

pixelId.description: pixel id, or its exact name, from list_meta_pixels

since.description: stats: start, ISO date or unix seconds

targetAdAccountId.description: share / unshare: the ad account to give the pixel to or take it from (one of this brand's)

tasks.description: assign_user: AA_ANALYZE, ADVERTISE, ANALYZE, EDIT, UPLOAD

until.description: stats: end, ISO date or unix seconds

userId.description: assign_user / remove_user: business-scoped user id from manage_meta_business list_people
